claims.content: The core curriculum (Kerncurriculum) comprises three topic areas (Themenbereiche), each with one compulsory module (Pflichtmodul) and one elective module (Wahlmodul).

claims.content: Three compulsory modules are worked through in a school year with two weekly lessons; across the six weekly lessons prescribed from grade 7 in Sekundarstufe I, nine compulsory modules in total must be covered.
